Annual Sports Day Celebration 2025

Track and field events and a march past brought the school together. From the Veerpatta school archive.

Back to the archive→

15 January 2025

Highlights from the day

  • 100m, 200m and relay races
  • Shot put and long jump
  • March past by the school houses
  • An award ceremony for young athletes

Parents and guests joined the school community to cheer on the young athletes.
